selection.selection_rule: Exact user-endorsed asset, appearance, native retention, semantics, additions, display gates, structure, physics, recency; unknown is not passed.
selection.scope: Best available display evidence among saved candidates; not a guarantee of physical or perceptual optimality.

selection.selector: Use stable native source face IDs in the declared Z-up frame. Hub estimate h=(-0.035,-0.295,-0.025) in native units; set metric p=0.49*(native-h). XY is the broad face; +Z is its normal, not the image vertical. theta=atan2(native_x-hx,native_y-hy), r=hypot(dx,dy). These are editable geometric estimates, not measurements. First assign the white outer pleated sheet to leaf_skin using the pale low-chroma surface connected across the outer annulus (initial r>0.21, theta within [-1.4,1.4]); follow the visible curved brown/white boundary using sampled native base-color texture and centroid continuity, retaining both thickness sides. Brown ribs, guards, hub and tails are the complementary faces. Do not classify UV islands as parts. Each source face has exactly one visible owner. Complementary brown faces with theta<-1.12, plus hub r<0.035 and unresolved tails with native_y<hy. Exclude all leaf faces.
selection.reason: The left outer guard and fastener provide an explicitly chosen grasp reference; unresolved fused tails remain here.

No recovery or physical success is claimed.

native_hub.reason: Estimated native-frame hub from rendered top view and geometry bounds

interactions.name: fold_control
interactions.action: Expose closure q in [0,pi/2] with native rest q=0; apply q_i=i*q/8 to all seven interior joints and q to the right guard. Positive +Z rotation brings the right guard toward the left. Use actual owner transforms and retain rest offsets.
interactions.expected: The guard and distributed ribs rotate at the shared hub while the full white covering contracts and pleats continuously; opening reverses the same control. Inspect static transformed poses 0, pi/4 and pi/2 for visible attachment only, never as endpoint/contact tests.

interactions.name: leaf_control
interactions.action: Expose local bend amplitude [-0.008,0.008] m centered between two middle support rays, using a smooth compact profile that vanishes on pinned edges. Apply nonrigid skin displacements on top of the folding bind map. This is a parameter preview, not a load trajectory.
interactions.expected: Several interior sheet vertices change relative to neighboring support rays while attached edges remain connected; output retains a real flex definition but no mj_step is run.

interactions.name: wave_control
interactions.action: Set finite grasp angle within +/-pi/6 and propagate the hierarchy including leaf support mapping.
interactions.expected: All attached parts move together while the folding and bending controls remain available.

review_requirements: During construction, account for every native face exactly once across the nine brown groups and leaf_skin, retaining UVs and materials. Confirm zero-control reconstruction preserves native positions through recorded scale/frame/rest offsets. Resolve leaf-boundary faces using texture and geometry together; do not leave pale sheet strips rigid solely because they fall outside the initial selector.

Using static preview transforms only at closure q=0, pi/4 and pi/2, inspect visible guard-to-leaf, rib-to-leaf and hub connections. Apply spread_i=i*q/8 consistently; the right guard must approach the left while the covering remains attached and visibly folds. Record material detachments or exposed partition seams. This is a construction binding inspection, not a physical endpoint, contact or trajectory test; no mj_step or range reduction.

Construct the declared nonempty coarse flex shell with explicit support-body assignments and deformable inter-rib nodes, plus a dedicated native leaf skin binding. At fixed rigid controls, changing the bounded leaf-bend parameter must visibly change interior sheet shape relative to its support rays while pinned edges remain attached. Retain native pleat/thickness offsets. Label this parameter preview, and run no load/unload or dynamics test.

Save GLB, editable Blender source, MJCF and interactive metadata before optional refinement. Bind closure, local leaf bending and finite grasp waving to their actual visible owners, including correct leaf propagation during waving. Publish after construction with explicit partial-closure and geometry limitations, physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0; create no simulated trajectories or physical-pass reports.

interaction_coverage.label: Open and partially close the fan
interaction_coverage.reason: The shared hub and radial ribs support bounded angular folding with the sheet attached.
interaction_coverage.limited_range_reason: The driving right guard retains the full 90-degree initial span. Only intermediate ribs move smaller proportional angles because the source and obs00_top show distributed ribs between the two guards; their coupled shares prevent all ribs rotating as one slab.

interaction_coverage.label: Wave the grasped assembly
interaction_coverage.reason: Finite +/-30 degree wrist-like whole-object motion about the grasped hub; chosen demo axis, not an intrinsic joint or continuous spinner.

interaction_coverage.label: Bend the pleated leaf locally
interaction_coverage.reason: Dedicated deforming render root and flex binding keep the visible sheet nonrigid. Browser parameter deflection is explicitly not simulated physics.

approximation_gaps.reason: Fused native inner ribs, imperfect gaps and grouped tails persist; no optional remeshing or added hidden supports.
Use simple slender boxes/capsules per brown group and coarse flex shell; stacking, self-contact and any neutral overlap are untested. No contact tests or range reductions are authorized.
Single coarse leaf continuum and proportional rib coupling approximate accordion folds. Exact crease mechanics, inextensibility and recovery are not established.
